reviewer_statement: Developer-side full scientific source-semantic review of frozen Python 1.2. Existing direct source oracle tests are supplemented by a second paired typed-Python test with asymmetric shapes, complete returned fields, the entire provenance map and exception-domain assertions. Exact-head Actions execution has not been observed; independent certification remains outstanding.
native_language_semantic_policy: Python frozen dataclass/NumPy arrays converted to validated R scientific list/S3/matrix or array objects. Source estimand and public numerical/provenance schema reviewed, not Python runtime type or arbitrary unsafe duck typing.

case_evidence.description: Typed fixed-profile generalized FoSR prediction-bootstrap input and confidence/profile-or-family calibration; native R source-shaped prediction and bootstrap records.
Finite non-square B-by-profile-by-observed-time bootstrap linear predictors, strictly positive finite robust delta-method standard errors, source binomial and Poisson links.
Profile-wise or complete-profile-family bootstrap maximum-standardized deviations, NumPy higher criticals, linear scale endpoints, and strictly monotone inverse-logit/exponential mean endpoints.
Zero or nonfinite linear predictor standard errors, malformed bootstrap profile/time geometry, invalid confidence and unsupported calibration scopes rejected.
Complete source prediction/bootstrap nesting, linearly calibrated lower/upper matrices, transformed mean bands, scalar inputs, maximum-statistics shape and nested provenance.

Fixed predeclared profile or complete-profile-family marginal mean bands on the observed grid, calibrated on linear scale; no fresh bootstrap, automatic profile selection or between-grid coverage guarantee.

independent_review_status: Provisional author-reviewed; exact-head CI and independent expert certification remain pending.
language_specific_limits: Python dataclass identities, arbitrary object protocols and exception classes cannot be identical to native R objects.
Source-generated finite scientific result domains are directly compared; arbitrary manually malformed object behavior is not claimed.
Author-reviewed scientific source parity is not independent certification or CRAN qualification.
